pages.task: Redraw the DRUID body, idle pose, nature-mage identity, strictly medieval, bold readable. Image 1 = pose/scale/framing reference (the current Druid; keep EXACT same pose, proportions, canvas, feet position, size). Image 2 = the old green hooded Archer; the Druid must clearly differ from it and from a russet/ochre bare-headed Archer. Empty hands (fists as in ref), no staff or weapon, real transparent background, no glow. Save at same canvas size as image 1 (566x452). CONCEPT: Bone-and-antler shaman: antler crown or horned skull headpiece (head not hooded), bone beads and talismans, pale hide wrap, ash-grey and bone-white with rust-red paint, tribal markings.
